subject: general
question: A train crosses a platform 90 metres long in 60 seconds at a speed of 54 km/h. Find the time the train will take to cross an electric pole.
solution:
**Given:**

Train crosses a platform of 90 m long in 60 seconds

Speed of train = 54 km/hr.

**Concept:**

Speed = {Distanceover Time}

Speed in meter/second = large{5over 18} km/h

When a train cross a pole it means the length of train is actual distance.

**Calculation:**

Let the length of train be x meter

Total distance covered by train = length of train + length of platform 

⇒ Total distance covered by train = (x + 90) m.

⇒ Speed of train in meter per second = large{5over 18}times 54

⇒ Speed of train in meter per second = 15 m/s

⇒ large {15={x+90over 60}}

⇒ large15 times 60 = x + 90

⇒ 900 = x + 90 

⇒ x = 900 - 90 

⇒ x = 810 meter 

Length of train = 810 meter 

Now,

⇒ The time taken by the train to cross an electric pole = large 810over 15

⇒ The time taken by the train to cross an electric pole = 54 sec.

**Hence, 'option 1' is the correct answer.**
